text: 近日，著名企业家、投资家段永平先生向安徽省安庆市桐城中学教育发展基金会捐赠人民币4500万元，专项用于该校多功能体艺馆建设。该笔捐赠创下该校单笔社会捐赠金额最高纪录。（澎湃）
text_en: Recently, Mr. Duan Yongping, a renowned entrepreneur and investor, donated RMB 45 million to the Education Development Foundation of Tongcheng Middle School in Tongcheng, Anqing City, Anhui Province, earmarked for the construction of the school's multifunctional sports and arts center. The donation set a record for the largest single social donation to the school. (The Paper)
